info.title: dtorkon API
info.description: FastAPI backend for the dtorkon mini-blog. The service handles admin-only auth, public/admin posts, site profile editing, analytics, SQLite persistence, searchable publishing, and backend-mediated uploads to Yandex Object Storage over the S3 API.
